content.title: 1 Mid-Cap Stock with Solid Fundamentals and 2 We Find Risky
content.summary: Mid-cap stocks have the best odds of scaling into $100 billion corporations thanks to their tested business models and large addressable markets. But the many opportunities in front of them attract significant competition, spanning from industry behemoths with seemingly infinite resources to small, nimble players with chips on their shoulders.

content.title: How Investors May Respond To International Paper (IP) Expanding Containerboard Production and Renewing Kraton Partnership
content.summary: Kraton Corporation recently announced the renewal of agreements with International Paper to ensure uninterrupted site services at Kraton’s Savannah, Georgia facility, while International Paper also revealed plans to convert its No. 16 paper machine at the Riverdale mill in Alabama to containerboard production by the third quarter of 2026. This collaboration highlights both companies’ focus on operational reliability, supply chain continuity, and long-term investments in sustainable packaging...

content.title: S&P 500 Slides for Fifth Day Ahead of Powell Speech
content.summary: Stock indexes drifted lower again Thursday ahead of Federal Reserve Chair  Jerome Powell’s  highly anticipated Jackson Hole speech.  The S&P 500 closed lower for a fifth consecutive day, though it is down only 1.5% over that period.  The broad-based index shed 0.4%, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average and Nasdaq Composite Index both fell 0.3%.
